storyTemplate.title: Sandbox Mythology Story
storyTemplate.description: A mythology start: reach a sacred threshold and decide how to answer the omen.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
Foam breaks over the lower temple steps though the tide is out.

A bronze bowl waits on the altar stone. Inside it, seawater turns against the wind, circling a black feather, a gold coin, and a shard of bone.

The temple doors are shut, but the omen is already speaking.
